places.name: Revelstoke
places.note: The city at the head of the valley, on the Trans-Canada Highway. The Columbia flows south from here toward the Upper Arrow Lake.

places.name: Beaton
places.note: A quiet settlement at the head of the lake’s northeast arm, near the old Arrowhead landing.

places.name: Halcyon
places.note: Home of Halcyon Hot Springs on the Upper Arrow Lake’s east shore.

places.name: Nakusp
places.note: The main town on the Arrow Lakes, with the Arrow Lakes Hospital, a waterfront walkway and hot springs up the Kuskanax valley.

places.name: Burton
places.note: Rebuilt on higher ground when the reservoir flooded the old townsite in 1968.

places.name: Fauquier
places.note: The east landing of the Needles cable ferry, which carries Highway 6 across the lake toward the Okanagan.

places.name: Edgewood
places.note: Moved up the hillside in the 1960s, when the reservoir drowned the original village.

places.name: Robson
places.note: On the north shore of the Columbia just above the Hugh Keenleyside Dam, which holds back the Arrow Lakes.

places.name: Castlegar
places.note: The city at the foot of the lakes, where the Kootenay River joins the Columbia. West Kootenay Regional Airport is here.

source: Place points from OpenStreetMap; census subdivisions from Statistics Canada (2021)
